words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr: adj.最大的【形容词big的最高级】
words.ex: This is the biggest apple I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最大的苹果。
words.en: Of the greatest size or extent; largest.

words.tr: v. 发展；发育；“develop”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 发达的；先进的；
words.ex: The country developed quickly after the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争后，这个国家迅速发展。
words.en: A developed country, industry, or system is advanced and has a lot of economic activity.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: He worked hard, and ultimately succeeded.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，最终成功了。
words.en: You use ultimately to indicate that something is the final result of a series of events or the most important part of a situation.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr: v. 迅速生长；急速增长
words.ex: The flowers burgeon in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，花朵绽放。
words.en: To grow or develop quickly; to flourish.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.tr:
v. 关心；担忧；照料
n. 注意；关心；护理
words.ex: She cares about her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她关心她的弟弟。
words.en: A misspelling of 'cares', meaning to feel concern or interest for someone or something.

words.ex: The first century had no computers.
words.ex_cn: 第一个世纪没有电脑。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years.

words.ex: The characteristics of this animal include long legs and big ears.
words.ex_cn: 这种动物的特征包括长腿和大耳朵。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: He completely forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他完全忘记了钥匙。
words.en: In a way that is whole or entire; to the fullest extent.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.tr: v. 合作；协作；“cooperate”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are cooperating to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在合作完成这个项目。
words.en: To work or act together toward a common end or purpose.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with flu last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被诊断出患了流感。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: The executives meet every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 高管们每周一开会。
words.en: Executives are people who have the power to make decisions and control a company or organization.

words.ex: He learned through experiential training.
words.ex_cn: 他通过基于经验的培训学习。
words.en: Relating to or derived from experience.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: Many graduates find jobs soon after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 许多毕业生在毕业后很快找到了工作。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a course of study at a college, university, or school, and has received a degree or diploma.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.tr: v. 包含； adj. 股份有限的；组成公司的；组成公司( incorporate的过去式和过；
words.ex: The recipe incorporated fresh herbs for better flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱包含了新鲜香草以提升风味。
words.en: If something is incorporated into a larger group, system, or area, it becomes part of it.

words.tr: v. 使混合；组成公司( incorporate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is incorporating sugar into the tea.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把糖混入茶中。
words.en: To include something as part of a larger group, system, or plan; to form a legal corporation.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: He is inquiring about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他正在询问火车时刻表。
words.en: If someone has an inquiring mind, they are interested in learning about many different things.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.tr: adj. 感兴趣的； v. “interest”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is interested in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他对读书感兴趣。
words.en: If you are interested in something, you want to give your attention to it and learn more about it.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: The builder bought new materials for the house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人为房子买了新材料。
words.en: Materials are substances or things used to make or build something, or to provide information or evidence.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.ex: There are different modes of transportation.
words.ex_cn: 有不同的出行方式。
words.en: Modes refer to the ways in which something is done or experienced, or the forms that something takes.

words.ex: He made careful observations about the birds.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细观察了这些鸟。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully, in order to gain information.

words.tr: adj. 冒犯的；令人不快的；进攻性的；
words.ex: His offensive words made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 他冒犯的话让她哭了。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behavior as offensive, you mean that it is rude or insulting.

words.tr: n. 所有权人；主人；物主；
words.ex: The owner of the house sold it last week.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的主人上周把它卖了。
words.en: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.tr: v. 表示"展示; 展现; 出示"； vt. & vi. （动词present的过去式及过去分词形式）；
words.ex: He presented his project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的项目。
words.en: If you present someone with something such as a prize or document, or if you present it to them, you formally give it to them.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: I ate a small pudding after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后吃了一小份布丁。
words.en: A sweet, creamy dessert typically made from milk, sugar, and a thickening agent such as gelatin or cornstarch.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；真正的；
words.ex: This is a real diamond, not fake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是假的。
words.en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr: v. 建议；推荐；“recommend”过去式和过去分词； adj. 被推荐的；
words.ex: The doctor recommended rest for two days.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议休息两天。
words.en: If something is recommended, it is suggested as being good or suitable for a particular purpose or job.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: He responds when the teacher asks a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师提问时，他会回答。
words.en: To say or do something as a reaction to something that has been said or done.

words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.tr: n. 根；根源；根本；“root”的复数；
words.ex: The roots of the equation are 2 and 3.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程的根是2和3。
words.en: The underground parts of a plant that anchor it and absorb water and nutrients.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: Practice can sharpen your skills.
words.ex_cn: 练习可以提高你的技能。
words.en: To make or become sharp or sharper.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他以喝咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.tr: v. 开始；创立；创始；发动（机器）；开动；出发，启程（start 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He started his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: If you start to do something, you do something that you were not doing before and you continue doing it.

words.ex: He is learning statics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他在物理课上学习静力学。
words.en: Statics is the branch of mechanics that deals with bodies at rest or forces in equilibrium.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: The bridge has strong structures to support weight.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构来承受重量。
words.en: Structures refer to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex. They can also denote buildings or other constructions standing as a whole.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.tr: v. 兴旺发达；蓬勃发展；“thrive”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The small town thrived after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这个小镇兴旺发达了。
words.en: If someone or something thrives, they do well and are successful, healthy, or strong.

words.tr: v. 扔；抛；掷；投； n. 投掷运动；投( throw的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is throwing the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: The act of propelling something with force through the air by a movement of the arm and hand.

words.tr: v. 丢弃；抛；“throw”的过去分词；
words.ex: He threw away the old book and was thrown it into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书丢进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you throw something, you send it through the air using your hand or arm.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: The company adopts new technologies to improve efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 公司采用新技术以提高效率。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow an idea, method, or course of action. It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr: n. 代理；代理处；“agency”的复数；
words.ex: The agencies help people find houses.
words.ex_cn: 这些代理帮助人们找房子。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: The agents helped the client find a house.
words.ex_cn: 这些代理人帮助客户找到了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着河走。
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: The park has many quiet areas for reading.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园有许多安静的区域可以读书。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a town, a country, a region, or the world.

words.tr: n. 模样；面貌；方面；朝向；“aspect”的复数；
words.ex: The aspects of the old house still look charming.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的外貌仍然很迷人。
words.en: a particular part or feature of something

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.ex: He had the audacity to lie to his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他竟敢对老板撒谎。
words.en: Audacity is the willingness to take bold risks, often in a way that shocks or surprises people.

words.tr: vt. 授予，奖给，判给；授予，奖给，判给（award的过去式与过去分词形式）；
words.ex: He was awarded a prize for his science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因他的科学项目而被授予奖项。
words.en: Given or assigned as a prize, compensation, or recognition.

words.tr: n. 特价商品；协议，交易( bargain的名词复数 ) v. 讨价还价，商谈( bargain；
words.ex: She bought many bargains at the weekend sale.
words.ex_cn: 她在周末促销时买了许多特价商品。
words.en: Goods or services offered at a lower price than usual, often due to a sale or discount.

words.ex: The police set up barriers on the road.
words.ex_cn: 警察在道路上设置了路障。
words.en: A barrier is a problem, rule, or situation that prevents someone from doing something, or that makes it difficult for them to do it.

words.ex: The remote needs new batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: Batteries are devices that store energy and convert it into electricity, used to power various devices.

words.tr: n. 利益；好处；“benefit”的复数； v. 有益于；有助于；
words.ex: The benefits of exercise are clear.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼的好处是显而易见的。
words.en: Benefits are advantages or profits that you get from something, especially advantages that you get from the government or from your employer, such as money or health insurance.

words.ex: This is a biological experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生物学实验。
words.en: Relating to biology or living organisms.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；烦闷的；厌倦的； v. 钻孔；“bore”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt bored during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: If you are bored, you feel tired and impatient because you have lost interest in something or because you have nothing to do.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速发展的；迅速生长的；迅速成长的
v. 发芽；抽枝；迅速发展；“burgeon”的现在分词
words.ex: The burgeoning town has many new shops.
words.ex_cn: 这个迅速发展的小镇有很多新商店。
words.en: If something burgeons, it grows or develops rapidly.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.tr: adj. 分类的; v. 分类（categorize 的过去式）
words.ex: The books are categorized by subject.
words.ex_cn: 这些书按主题分类。
words.en: To place into or assign to a category; classify.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: He faces many challenges every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天面临许多挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: The coach used coercive methods to make players train harder.
words.ex_cn: 教练使用了强制性手段让球员更努力地训练。
words.en: Coercive actions or powers are used to force people to do things that they are unwilling to do.

words.ex: He enjoys collecting stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢收集邮票。
words.en: The act of gathering items together, especially as a hobby or for study.

words.ex: He collects old coins and keeps them in collections.
words.ex_cn: 他收集旧硬币并把它们保存成收藏品。
words.en: A group of objects or works to be seen, studied, or kept together.

words.ex: He is a collector of old coins.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位古钱币收藏家。
words.en: A collector is a person who collects things of a particular type as a hobby or for investment.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.tr: v. 抱怨，诉苦，投诉；申诉，控诉，抗议；诉说，申诉；抱怨，诉苦，投诉( complain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He complained about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨邻居很吵。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.tr:
v. 包含；
vt. 包含；容纳；
words.ex: This box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr: v. （靠近或作比较时）显出明显的差异，形成对比( contrast的过去式和过去分词 ); 对比，
words.ex: The two paintings contrasted sharply with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两幅画形成了鲜明的对比。
words.en: To show differences when compared.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr: v. 覆盖；“cover”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有遮盖物的；有顶的；
words.ex: The snow covered the ground.
words.ex_cn: 雪覆盖了地面。
words.en: If something is covered, it has a layer of something else over it, or it is hidden or protected by something.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: We wrote the dates on the calendar.
words.ex_cn: 我们把日期写在日历上。
words.en: Particular days of the month or year, often specified for events, meetings, or deadlines.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.tr: n. 决定物，决定因素( determinant的名词复数 )
words.ex: He calculates determinants for matrices in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上计算矩阵的行列式。
words.en: Factors or elements that decisively influence the nature or outcome of something.

words.tr: v. 发展；发育；“develop”的现在分词； adj. 发展中的；
words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: A developing country or area of the world is poorer and has less advanced industries, especially in Africa, Latin America, or Asia.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The effectiveness of the new medicine was proven in trials.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药的有效性在试验中得到了证实。
words.en: The ability to produce a desired or intended result.

words.tr: n. 影响；效果；效应；作用；“effect”的复数；
words.ex: The effects of pollution are harmful to animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染对动物有有害的影响。
words.en: Effects refer to the results or consequences of an action or other cause.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.tr: n. 元素；要素（尤指）风雨；“element”的复数；
words.ex: The elements battered the small cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风雨在暴风雨中猛烈袭击了小木屋。
words.en: The elements of something are the basic parts or aspects of it.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.tr: n. 散发；排放；放射；“emission”的复数
words.ex: Cars produce harmful emissions.
words.ex_cn: 汽车产生有害的排放物。
words.en: Emissions are substances that are sent out into the air, especially by vehicles or industrial processes.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.tr: v. 使能够，提供做…的权利[措施]；使可； adj. 激活的 v. 使能够，提供做…的权利[措施]( enable的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The new app enabled her to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 这个新应用程序使她能够在家工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.tr: v. 鼓励；鼓舞；促进；鼓动；“encourage”的现在分词； adj. 鼓舞人心的；鼓励的；
words.ex: My teacher encouraged me to try again.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我再试一次。
words.en: If something is encouraging, it gives you hope or confidence.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: He bought equity in a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了一家科技公司的股票。
words.en: Equity is the quality of being fair and impartial.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.tr: v. 估算；估价；“estimate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He estimated the cost of the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他估算了一下旅行的费用。
words.en: An estimated amount or quantity is one that is based on a guess or calculation, rather than on exact measurement.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.tr: adv. 确切地；正是；准确地；
words.ex: He arrived exactly at 8 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他正好在八点到达。
words.en: In a precise manner; accurately.

words.ex: He shows examples of good writing.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了优秀写作的例子。
words.en: Instances or samples that illustrate a point, demonstrate a concept, or serve as models.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.tr: adj. 令人激动的；使人兴奋的； v. “excite”的现在分词；
words.ex: The football match was exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这场足球赛令人激动。
words.en: If something is exciting, it makes you feel very happy or enthusiastic.

words.ex: The execution of the criminal was carried out last night.
words.ex_cn: 这名罪犯的处决昨晚执行了。
words.en: The carrying out or performance of a task, plan, or order.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.tr: v. 探索；游览；“explore”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are exploring the forest to find new plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在探索森林以寻找新的植物。
words.en: To travel through or examine an area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: Poor diet and lack of sleep are factors in his illness.
words.ex_cn: 饮食不良和睡眠不足是他生病的因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, a decision, or a situation.

words.tr: v. 吃；喂；“feed”的现在分词； n. 饲养；给食；
words.ex: The baby is feeding on milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在喝奶。
words.en: The act of giving food to a person or an animal.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.tr: 短语动词. 填写（表格等）；变得丰满
words.ex: She is filling out the application form for the job.
words.ex_cn: 她正在填写工作申请表。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.tr: n. (调查或研究的）结果；发现；
words.ex: The study's findings show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的结果表明，睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The results of an investigation or research; something that is discovered.

words.ex: I have five apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有五个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of two and three; one more than four, or half of ten.

words.tr: v. 集中；聚焦；“focus”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is focusing on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: The formation of clouds happens when water vapor cools.
words.ex_cn: 云的形成发生在水蒸气冷却时。
words.en: The process of forming or making something, or the way something is formed or made.

words.tr: v. 创办；建立；“found”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He founded a school for poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一所为贫困儿童设立的学校。
words.en: If someone founds something such as a company, an organization, or an institution, they start it or create it.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；性冷淡的（女子）
words.ex: The water is frigid in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的水很冰冷。
words.en: Frigid means extremely cold in temperature or lacking warmth or enthusiasm.

words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；“furnish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 配备家具的；
words.ex: They furnished the apartment with new tables and chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他们给公寓布置了新的桌椅。
words.en: If a room or building is furnished, it is equipped with furniture.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.tr: adj. 增加的；增长的；增强的； v. 生长；成长；种植；渐渐变成；“grow”的现在分词； n. 成长；
words.ex: The growing demand for clean water is a big problem.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水日益增加的需求是一个大问题。
words.en: Increasing in size or amount; developing.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: She completed a 675-hour training program.
words.ex_cn: 她完成了一个675小时的培训项目。
words.en: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr: v. 确认；鉴定；认出；“identify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The police identified the suspect from the photo.
words.ex_cn: 警察从照片中确认了嫌疑人。
words.en: If you identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: The story includes an illustration of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事包含了一个善良的例证。
words.en: An illustration is a picture or diagram that helps make something clear or attractive.

words.tr: v. 包含，合并；组成公司；掺和，混合（成分）（incorporates 的第三人称单数）
words.ex: This new model incorporates several new features.
words.ex_cn: 这款新模型包含了几项新功能。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The answer is incorrect.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是不正确的。
words.en: If something is incorrect, it is not accurate or true.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 增长的；增多的； v. 增加；“increase”的现在分词；
words.ex: The increasing population needs more food.
words.ex_cn: 增长的人口需要更多的食物。
words.en: Becoming greater in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 工业化的； v. “industrialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The country became industrialized in the 20th century.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在20世纪实现了工业化。
words.en: An industrialized country or area has a lot of industries and factories.

words.tr: adj. 感染病菌的； v. 感染；“infect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The wound was infected with bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 伤口被细菌感染了。
words.en: If a person or animal is infected with a disease-causing organism, the organism has entered their body and started to multiply.

words.ex: The virus infects people through coughs.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒通过咳嗽传染人。
words.en: To cause a disease or illness to spread to a person, animal, or plant.

words.ex: The teacher tried to infuse confidence into the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师试图向学生注入信心。
words.en: If you infuse a quality into someone or something, you fill them with it. If a quality infuses something, it is present throughout it.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: The teacher instructs the students to complete their homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生们完成他们的作业。
words.en: To instruct someone means to teach them a subject or skill, or to give them information or orders.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr: v. 引进；介绍；提出； adj. [医]引种的，引进的；提出( introduce的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school introduced a new math program last year.
words.ex_cn: 学校去年引进了一个新的数学课程。
words.en: If you introduce someone to something, you cause them to learn about it or experience it for the first time.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.ex: He takes piano lessons every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上钢琴课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.tr: v. 举起，抬起( lift的过去式和过去分词 )；提高；解除（封锁、包围等）；
words.ex: He lifted the box easily.
words.ex_cn: 他轻松地举起了箱子。
words.en: To move something or someone upwards or to a higher position.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr: n. 生活；生命；“life”的复数； v. 居住；生活；
words.ex: Their lives are simple but happy.
words.ex_cn: 他们的生活简单但幸福。
words.en: The condition that distinguishes animals and plants from inorganic matter, including the capacity for growth, reproduction, functional activity, and continual change preceding death; the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: This is the longest river in the country.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个国家最长的河流。
words.en: Superlative form of long: having the greatest length.

words.ex: She wore the shirt loosely over her jeans.
words.ex_cn: 她宽松地把衬衫穿在牛仔裤外面。
words.en: In a way that is not firmly or tightly fixed in place; not strictly or precisely.

words.ex: The magnet shows strong magnetism.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁显示出很强的磁性。
words.en: Magnetism is a physical phenomenon produced by the motion of electric charge, resulting in attractive and repulsive forces between objects.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: The government took new measures to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了新措施来减少污染。
words.en: Measures are actions taken or plans made to achieve a particular purpose or to solve a problem. It can also refer to the size, length, or amount of something, determined by measuring.

words.ex: The students are using microphones for their presentation.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在演讲时使用麦克风。
words.en: A microphone is a device that converts sound into electrical signals, used in recording or amplifying sound.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.tr: n. 分子( molecule的名词复数 )
words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢分子和一个氧分子组成。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr: n. 神话；神话学；神话集；
words.ex: He loves reading Greek mythology.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读希腊神话。
words.en: Mythology is a collection of myths, especially one belonging to a particular religious or cultural tradition.

words.tr:
adj. 狭窄的；窄小的；
v. 使窄小；
words.ex: The road is narrow and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路很窄，开车很难。
words.en: If something narrows, or if you narrow it, it becomes less wide.

words.tr: v. （使）变窄； adj. [医]狭窄的 v. （使）变窄( narrow的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The road narrowed near the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这条路在桥附近变窄了。
words.en: If something narrows, it becomes less wide or less broad.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.tr: adj. 冒犯的；令人不快的；进攻性的；
words.ex: His offensive words made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 他冒犯的话让她哭了。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behavior as offensive, you mean that it is rude or insulting.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上。
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.tr: v. 操作；经营；运转； adj. 运转( operate的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He operated the machine carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地操作了这台机器。
words.en: To operate means to control the functioning of a machine, process, or system, or to perform a surgical operation.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；“operate”的现在分词； adj. 运行的；
words.ex: The machine is operating smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转得很顺畅。
words.en: Operating refers to the action of functioning or working, especially in a business or medical context.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: Many organisations help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 许多组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organisation is a group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.ex: The outcomes of the experiment were surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验的结果令人惊讶。
words.en: The results or consequences of actions or events.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: Physicists study how things move and work.
words.ex_cn: 物理学家研究事物是如何运动和工作的。
words.en: A physicist is a scientist who specializes in the field of physics, which involves the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature.

words.ex: The physiologist studied how the heart pumps blood.
words.ex_cn: 这位生理学家研究了心脏如何泵血。
words.en: A physiologist is a person who studies the way that the bodies of living things work.

words.tr: n. [天]行星；星球；星球（planet 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The planets move around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 行星围绕太阳运行。
words.en: A planet is a celestial body moving in an elliptical orbit around a star.

words.ex: The museum displays old portraits of kings and queens.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了国王和王后的旧肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.ex: He will possibly come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天可能会来。
words.en: You use possibly to indicate that something is true or might be true, but you are not certain.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: n. 业务；练习；实践；惯常做法；“practice”的复数；
words.ex: The company improves its business practices every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会改进其业务。
words.en: The act of doing something regularly or repeatedly to improve skill or to follow a custom or law.

words.tr: v. 练习；实践；惯常地进行；“practice”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is practicing piano every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习钢琴。
words.en: Engaged in a specified profession or activity, especially on a regular basis.

words.tr: v. 预测；预言；“predict”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The weather forecast predicted rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报预测明天有雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.tr: v. 给……开（药），让……采用（疗法）；开处方；规定，命令（prescribe 的现在分词）；
words.ex: The doctor is prescribing medicine for his cough.
words.ex_cn: 医生正在给他开药治疗咳嗽。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment, he or she says what medicine or treatment a patient should have.

words.tr: adj. 盛行的；有优势的；普遍的； v. “prevail”的现在分词；
words.ex: The prevailing weather today is sunny.
words.ex_cn: 今天盛行的天气是晴天。
words.en: The prevailing thing in a particular place or at a particular time is the one that is most common or strongest at that place or time.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: He radically changed his mind about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底改变了对这个计划的想法。
words.en: In a way that is very different from the usual or traditional way.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: Realists know that life is not always fair.
words.ex_cn: 现实主义者知道生活并不总是公平的。
words.en: Realists are people who recognize and accept the true nature of a situation and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.tr: v. 减少；降低；减量；“reduce”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 减少的；简化的；没落的；
words.ex: The company reduced its costs last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年减少了成本。
words.en: If something is reduced, it has been made smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: This symbol represents the number five.
words.ex_cn: 这个符号代表数字五。
words.en: 1. To stand for or symbolize something. 2. To act or speak officially for someone or something. 3. To describe or depict something in a particular way.

words.tr: v. 需要；要求；“require”的现在分词；
words.ex: This job is requiring more time than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要比预期更多的时间。
words.en: If something is required, it must be had or obtained because it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: He responds when the teacher asks a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师提问时，他会回答。
words.en: To say or do something as a reaction to something that has been said or done.

words.ex: The teacher read all the responses from the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师读了所有学生的回答。
words.en: Answers, reactions, or replies to a question, statement, or stimulus.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的；
words.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张单程公交车票。
words.en: Only one in number; one only; not married or not involved in a stable romantic relationship.

words.ex: He is a sociable man who likes to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢和朋友聊天的外向的人。
words.en: A sociable person is friendly and enjoys being with other people.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: Can you tell me the specifics of the plan?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我这个计划的细节吗？
words.en: The specifics of something are the particular details of it.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: v. 传播；扩散；展开；散布；“spread”的现在分词；
words.ex: The virus is spreading quickly in the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒正在这座城市迅速传播。
words.en: The act of extending over a larger or increasing area or scope; the diffusion or dissemination of something.

words.ex: He walked up the stairs to his bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去他的卧室。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: He is stating his opinion clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在清楚地表达自己的观点。
words.en: To state means to express something in speech or writing, especially clearly and definitely.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr: adj. 结构化的；有条理的； v. “structure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher gave a structured plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师为这个项目提供了一个结构化的计划。
words.en: Arranged in a clear, organized way, often with a particular pattern or system.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: There was a sudden noise in the night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里突然传来一阵响声。
words.en: If something is sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: We have sufficient food for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们有足够的食物用于这次旅行。
words.en: If something is sufficient for a particular purpose, there is enough of it for the purpose.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: He aims at his targets every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在瞄准他的目标。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: The teams worked together to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这些团队合作赢得了比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who work together on a particular task or project.

words.ex: He learned new techniques to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了新的技术来修理这台机器。
words.en: Techniques are methods or ways of doing something, especially those that require skill.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: The temperatures are very high in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气温很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: He tended to arrive late for meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他总是倾向于迟到。
words.en: To regularly or frequently behave in a particular way or have a certain characteristic. Or to care for or look after someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.tr: n. 面巾纸；手巾纸；“tissue”的复数；
words.ex: She wiped her nose with a tissue.
words.ex_cn: 她用一张面巾纸擦了鼻子。
words.en: A tissue is a piece of soft thin paper which is used for wiping, especially for wiping the nose. In biology, tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to do a particular job.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: I can't tolerate loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 我无法容忍巨大的噪音。
words.en: If you tolerate a situation or person, you accept them although you do not particularly like them.

words.tr: v. 旅游；旅行；“travel”的现在分词； n. 旅行；旅游；游历； adj. 旅行的；巡回的；旅行用的；
words.ex: I love traveling to new countries.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢去新的国家旅游。
words.en: Moving or going from one place to another, especially over a long distance.

words.ex: There are twenty-six letters in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 英文字母有二十六个。
words.en: The number 26, following twenty-five and preceding twenty-seven.

words.ex: There are different types of dogs.
words.ex_cn: 有不同类型的狗。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.ex: The volunteers help at the food bank every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这些志愿者每个周末都在食品银行帮忙。
words.en: People who offer to do something without being forced to do it, especially work that helps other people.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.tr: adj. 担忧的；焦虑的；发愁的； v. 担心；担忧；“worry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was worried about his test results.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的考试成绩。
words.en: If you are worried, you are unhappy because you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.tr:
adv. 还；然而；
conj. 然而；
words.ex: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.
